lines.text: SUB BY : DENI AUROR@ https://aurorarental.blogspot.com/ Are you ready, kids?

* oh... * * who lives in a pineapple under the sea? * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * absorbent and yellow and porous is he. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * if nautical nonsense be something you wish... * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * then drop on the deck and flop like a fish. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * ready? Spongebob Squarepants! * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * Spongebob Squarepants! *
Well, i'm bubbles for you, Sandy.
Patrick's going to love the one you made for him.
Take me through the plan again.
Step one: Patrick and i get to the valentine's day carnival.
Step two: i position Patrick and myself on top of the ferris wheel.
Step three: you arrive at designated checkpoint for maximum visual contact.
Spongebob, what are you doing in there?
Spongebob is stuck inside this rock.
And i have a present for you.
But you can't have it yet.
Is it ready now? Not yet.
Do you want to ruin the surprise?
Tell me, tell me, tell me... please!
Now, take that quarter And buy some cotton candy.
Cotton candy, i can't believe it!
I got a visual... want me to bring her in?
Patrick's still trying to guess what his valentine is.
You are such a kidder. Sandy out.
So, if it's not cotton candy, then what is it?
I can't find it here in the carnival Because it's on top of mount climb-Up- And-Fall-Off!
You can bring it in now.
Spongebob, we've got a little problem.
I got a pack of chocolate-Eating scallops trying to rustle the balloon.
I'm going to be a little late.
Take him up to the ferris wheel And i'll meet you there.
If Patrick doesn't get his valentine...
I'm pretty sure it's not up there, Spongebob!
Patrick! Actually it's on the ferris...
I'm ready for the greatest valentine present In the whole world now, Spongebob.
Well, this is where you're going to get it... i hope.
Just keep looking out there, pal.
Spongebob to Sandy, Spongebob to Sandy.
I got my ox in a hitch here.
The scallops are eating the balloon!
No b, Sandy, no b. No!
Uh, Patrick, you know how Sometimes you plan something special And things just don't work out?
Is it hot up here or what?!
At first a handshake doesn't seem like much But... really it's the thought that counts.
Hey, Spongebob, i just wanted to thank you for this box of chocolates.
I mean, even though i was expecting more...
Not that it matters that we've been friends for so long...
Hey, Spongebob, thanks for the bike.
I just met him this morning.
Excuse me, do you guys have the time?
There's a chubby pink starfish on the loose!
Now i'm going to break something of yours!
Okay, Patrick, i know i deserve this, but do they?
They didn't give me anything, either.
Nope, it's too late for that now...
Whoo-Hoo! Look, Patrick, it's here! It's here!
The best valentine in the whole wide world is right behind you!
I'm telling you it's right there. Turn around!
You must think i'm pretty dumb, huh?
I'm going to say this once And i'm not going to say it again, so pay attention.
I am not, i repeat Not going to turn around for any reason ever.
You didn't have to give me anything.
You dropped this piece of paper.
I just figured you probably want it back.
But, Squidward, in the right hands This paper is a gold mine of entertainment.
A spectacular afternoon of underwater fun.
Does that mean i can have it?
Yes, by all means, take it.
Yes! For the final time I don't want that paper.
Last chance to change your mind, Squidward.
And promise me, no matter how much i may beg and plead and cry Don't give that paper back to me... ever!
So, i take that as a possible no?
Okay, Squidward, that's a promise i'll just have to keep.
I am so lucky to have a friend like Squidward.
What in the world are you giggling about?
It's just that i'm thinking of all the fun i'm going to have With this piece of paper!
How can anyone have fun with just a piece of paper?
Doh! What can he possibly be doing with that paper?
Well, yes, Gary I am a sponge with paper stuck in his pants But i'm also super sponge soaking up crime.
Ugh... Spongebob junglepants summon animal friends.
You're right, Gary I'm not a jungle boy.
I am a box of army supplies Bringing relief to the hungry troops!
Landing just in time for... the bullfight!
Look at me, i'm a guy with a mustache.
A pirate with an eye patch.
A regular guy with an eye patch.
Arr, i am not a pirate.
Do a big yellow idiot with a stupid piece of paper.
Hey, that little paper does seem like fun.
Spongebob, honestly, and his dumb paper.
Now, reading boring science digest, that's fun.
See, i can have fun taking a bath.
Painting fruit-- There's nothing more fun than painting fruit.
This is more fun than anything.
I'll prove to him that paper is not fun!
* i'm having fun, la-La-La. * * isn't it great, la-La-La-La-La * * la-La * * la-La-La-La... * Okay, Spongebob, top this one.
Hey, little Squidward, what's gray and ugly and has six arms?
I don't know, but have you looked in the mirror lately?
Oh, that's a good one, Squidward, now let me try.
Have you heard any good jokes, mr. Paper?
What happened to the paper that fell in the ocean?
I don't know, what happened to the paper that fell in the ocean?
Ha, ha, i'm having so much fun with my new shell cart.
Hey, Spongebob, can your stupid paper do this?
Well, you can't play music with a piece of paper!
All those wrong notes you played Made it sound more original.
What? I didn't play any wrong notes.
Yeah, see, you're playing it like this...
When ordinarily it goes like this...
I'm partial to doing it in the key of a-Minor, myself.
Ah, nothing like a duet between buddies, eh, Squidward?
I said let go of it!
Let go, let go, let go...
What do you mean you can't?
You made me promise No matter how much you begged and pleaded and cried Not to give the paper back to you ever.
I never said anything like that.
And promise me, no matter how much i may beg and plead and cry Don't give that paper back to me... ever!
No, i don't want to see it again.
Sorry, Squidward, i am sworn to a promise.
Wait, wait, maybe we can trade for something.
I'm going to make you an offer.
You drive a hard bargain, Squidward.
Not the lint, the rubber band.
Don't worry, Squidward, i won't let you down.
You are not going anywhere until we strike a deal.
Well, that's the last of it.
I've given you everything but the shirt off my back.
Oh... Squidward, is this still part of the test?
Because it's... it's really getting Harder and harder to keep my promise.
I... i've always loved that shirt.
I can break a promise for this.
Squidward, do you want your other stuff?
You can have all that junk, because now i've got this.
I've got the paper, and you've got my useless garbage.
I got it! Ha, ha, ha.
I got it, you're a sucker.
What should we try first, mr. Paper? Impressions!
A guy with a piece of paper on his nose.
Look at me, i'm a guy with a piece of paper...
That's right, that's right, here we go now.
I'm flying, flying, flying, flying, flying, flying...
A guy throwing a piece of paper on the ground!
A guy stomping on the piece of paper!
I'm a guy who traded everything he owns for...
Hey, thanks, it's just what i needed, Squidward.
